privacy.basis: measured at pinned ProtoType 335e0e8: index.html + src/gamesets/022_Login.ts; re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Pilot for Issue #81. Heavy Vite SPA — ~1.5MB JS bundle (gsap + three.js + pixi.js). Upstream now carries an operator-owned MIT LICENSE (added by ProtoType#4 / PR rebuildup/ProtoType#5, merge commit 335e0e8), so the previously provisional 'same operator / Berne Convention' framing is now backed by an explicit permissive license. The intermediate `--ignore-scripts` / `build.security.ignore_scripts` workaround was removed at the same time because the obfuscated `preinstall.js` lifecycle script has been deleted upstream.

tools.description: A local-first reading app for the browser. PDFs in MVP; EPUB/Markdown/text next. Designed to embed as a Tool in my-web-2026.

privacy.basis: measured at pinned readmark 8895959 (ADR-0008 storage-free redesign, merged via readmark PR #86): no external origin in index.html or src/**, and a sandboxed-frame run observed ZERO third-party requests (every request went to the serving origin; fonts.googleapis / fonts.gstatic are gone with the webfont); re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: PDF reading MVP (pdfjs-dist 5.x + React Router; Dexie removed). Uses bun as package manager. COOP/COEP headers required for SharedArrayBuffer pdfjs decode — host already serves https via rebuildup.dev canonical origin, so headers are deployable. Storage (Issue #786 / readmark ADR-0008): readmark keeps NO browser storage — documents, metadata and reading state live in a per-tab in-memory session store, and the library says so in one line. The sandboxed frame's opaque origin (every storage API denied, measured) therefore no longer matters: a reload starts an empty library by design. Zero external origins, so no consent gate.

tools.description_ja: ビジネスメールの文面をブロック単位で組み立てるツール。挨拶・依頼・謝罪などの定型文を並べ替え、署名付きのメールを作れます。

iframe.sandbox_rationale: business-mail-block の「ダウンロード」ボタンは、組み立てたメールを .txt として、テンプレートを .json として保存する（src/components/useMailBlockState.ts#downloadEmail が a[download] をクリックする）。sandbox に allow-downloads がないと、ブラウザは frame 内のダウンロードをすべて拒否するため、この Tool の書き出し機能は host 内でフレームに載せると死んでいた（実測: allow-downloads なしの build では同じボタンで download イベントが発火しなかった）。downloads は frame 内で生成した内容を訪問者のディスクに書き出すだけで、host origin のデータも第三者にも触れないため、宣言して許可する（Issue #465 の conditional token は allow と理由の記述を要求する）。

privacy.basis: measured at pinned business-mail-block e88be11f: the standalone Vite build output (dist/index.html + dist/assets/*) and the source (index.html, src/**) carry no URL that is fetched on load — the only absolute URLs in the bundle are XML namespace constants (www.w3.org) and library error-documentation links (react.dev, redux.js.org) that are never requested; no localStorage / sessionStorage / indexedDB / cookie usage and no camera / microphone API, so the opaque-origin sandbox affects nothing; the file download the Tool offers is a blob URL it creates inside the frame (URL.createObjectURL), so it contacts no origin at all; re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Standalone Vite build merged via rebuildup/tool-business-mail-block PR #5 (commit e88be11f55bde1bd6ac6fd3b2776a45c83eb9134 = pinned submodule HEAD, verified with git ls-remote + submodule status). Build: bun (bun.lock present, `vite build`, packageManager bun@1.4.2); LICENSE (MIT) present in the checkout. Measured at the pin: no external origin contacted on load, no browser-storage usage, no camera / microphone API — so the sandbox grants no Permissions-Policy feature and the frame keeps its opaque origin. The Tool's own copy path falls back to `document.execCommand('copy')` when `navigator.clipboard` is unavailable in the opaque-origin frame (read at the pin in src/components/useMailBlockState.ts); measured on the built preview, the コピー button does put the composed mail on the clipboard through that fallback. The Tool also offers a `.txt` / `.json` file download (src/components/useMailBlockState.ts): measured on the built preview with `sandbox="allow-scripts"` the browser discarded it (no download event), and with `allow-downloads` added the same button produces one — that is why the sandbox carries the token and `delivery.iframe.allow` declares the `downloads` capability. `downloads` is a sandbox-only capability (src/http/security-headers.json#sandbox_only_capabilities): it has no Permissions-Policy header half, so the grant is the sandbox token alone.

iframe.sandbox_rationale: code-type-p5 の「Export PNG Sequence (ZIP)」は、描画したフレームを ZIP にまとめて保存する（src/lib/001_Editors/003_VideoEncoder.ts#finalizeZip が a[download] をクリックする）。sandbox に allow-downloads がないと、ブラウザは frame 内のダウンロードをすべて拒否するため、この Tool の書き出し機能は host 内でフレームに載せると死んでいた。downloads は frame 内で生成した ZIP を訪問者のディスクに書き出すだけで、host origin のデータも第三者にも触れないため、宣言して許可する（Issue #465 の conditional token は allow と理由の記述を要求する）。

purpose.ja: 読み込みを開始すると、埋め込み中の Code Type p5 は p5.js 本体の翻訳ファイル（例: p5@2.3/translations/ja/translation.json）を cdn.jsdelivr.net から取得します。ブラウザの言語が日本語のときに実際に取得されることを実測で確認しています。
purpose.en: Once the load starts, the embedded Code Type p5 fetches the p5.js translation files (e.g. p5@2.3/translations/ja/translation.json) from cdn.jsdelivr.net. Measured: the request really happens when the browser language is Japanese.

privacy.basis: measured at pinned code-type-p5 2e119311: index.html and src/** contain no external origin of their own; the contact comes from the p5.js runtime the Tool bundles. p5's i18next backend (node_modules/p5/lib/p5.esm.js, `backend.loadPath = https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@${major.minor}/translations/{{lng}}/{{ns}}.json`) is initialised on p5 startup, and a Playwright run against the built artifact with locale ja-JP observed exactly one external request: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@2.3/translations/ja/translation.json. The same run with the default en locale requested nothing external, because the English strings are bundled. The granted sandbox capability (allow-downloads) adds no third-party contact: the exported ZIP is produced inside the frame and never uploaded anywhere. re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Standalone Vite build merged via rebuildup/tool-code-type-p5 PR #5 (commit 2e1193111faa837d3653d72410aa0e3c97a176b3 = pinned submodule HEAD, verified with git ls-remote + submodule status). Build: bun (bun.lock present, `vite build`); LICENSE (MIT) present in the checkout. Measured at the pin: no browser-storage usage under sandbox="allow-scripts", and the only third-party contact is the p5.js translation fetch described in delivery.privacy. Bundle: 1,482,260 B of JS, inside the shared 1,600,000 B Tool cap.

purpose.ja: 画像ウィジェットや YouTube ウィジェットを設定すると、埋め込み中の Pomodoro は外部に通信します。画像ウィジェットは読み込みに失敗した画像の代替として via.placeholder.com から画像を取得し、YouTube ウィジェットは www.youtube.com の埋め込み文書（/embed/…）を読み込み、音声の埋め込み機能を使う場合は同オリジンの iframe API（/iframe_api）を読み込みます。
purpose.en: Once an image widget or a YouTube widget is configured, the embedded Pomodoro contacts two third parties. The image widget fetches a replacement image from via.placeholder.com when the configured image fails to load, and the YouTube widget loads the www.youtube.com embed document (/embed/…) plus, for the audio embed, the iframe API of the same origin (/iframe_api).

privacy.basis: measured at pinned pomodoro 7ce10d78: index.html has no external origin; the contacts come from src/components/widgets/WidgetImageContent.tsx:103 (an whose onError handler swaps the src to https://via.placeholder.com/300?text=Image+Error — an image request, not a link), src/components/widgets/WidgetMusicContent.tsx:21 (an

tools.description_ja: マイク入力のレベルを OBS のミキサーと同じ目盛りで表示し、5 秒のテストから -14 dBFS に近づけるゲイン調整量を提案するツール。音声はブラウザの外へ送信しません。
tools.description: Browser-only microphone level meter that mirrors the OBS Audio Mixer zones (-50 / -20 / -9 / -0.5 dBFS) and recommends a +/- dB gain delta toward -14 dBFS from a 5-second speech check. Audio never leaves the browser.

privacy.basis: measured at pinned mic-level 9506e461: the built bundle contacts no third-party origin at load time — the only absolute URLs in dist are the XML/SVG/MathML namespace identifiers (www.w3.org, never fetched), React's error-doc URL (react.dev/errors, a link inside an error message) and the OBS documentation link (obsproject.com, an <a href> the visitor has to click); the bundle's single fetch() is React's own same-origin module preload, and src/** contains no fetch / XHR / sendBeacon / WebSocket and no localStorage / sessionStorage / indexedDB, so the frame needs no storage fallback; re-measure after a bump

tools.notes: Standalone Vite build merged via rebuildup/tool-mic-level PR #4 (commit 9506e4619541d8912346648ced1239607acea199 = pinned submodule HEAD, verified with git ls-remote + submodule status). Build: bun (bun.lock present, `vite build`); LICENSE (MIT) present in the checkout. Microphone: `delivery.iframe.allow: microphone` is mirrored into the host-side Permissions-Policy grant (src/tools/registry.ts#toolRouteSecurityPolicy) and the artefact-side grant (public/_headers `/tools/mic-level/app/*`). Measured at the pin: dist = index.html 513 B + assets/index-DI3G-JcY.js 248,619 B (gzip 78.20 kB), zero third-party origins, no browser-storage usage. Measured in the host preview: the retained `sandbox="allow-scripts"` leaves the frame on an opaque origin, so getUserMedia is refused (SecurityError) until ADR-0020 §2.1 lands — the measurements are in docs/verification/tools/mic-level-host-activation.md.
